simple.meaning: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist ; transitively, to attain , i.e. find or acquire ; figuratively, to occur , meet or be present
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָצָא (H4672) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 457 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
